notes.title: Building graphics coming, new trailer perhaps too.
notes.notes:
Too many people were asking "What are those Green rectangles" and feeling generally confused about them (they are buildings), and although one Alpha tester commented that after he understood they were buildings, he preferred them over actual building images, I decided to add those building images and have been doing that for last month already and they are almost finished for the first try.

At some point, I will likely update the current trailer to contain those building graphics so you can see the new-fangled dangled building graphics and stop wondering about those green rectangles what they are, as with the building graphics included, they obviously are buildings now.

Personally, I too prefer just the green rectangles without building graphics since it leaves more space for imagination, not to mention I made one of the levels look a bit like a castle with those rectangles, which idea is now gone due to graphics, and think it looked actually better without buildings, but when having seen the buildings once, you do not want them out anymore. So for better or worse, they are there now.
 
Here is the bit like a castle look-a-like with the buildings:
[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/44305687/1711dd2d35506b16d89bd43d66ea69beec5c236a.png[/img]

And here is the same without the buildings:
[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/44305687/c215b05bf2cf127056d5c290dcacec9a855e5464.png[/img]


Without buildings, you can notice some of the rectangles are clearly thicker, as in corners having higher towers and middle too, like in the castle wall, but you won't notice that anymore after the buildings are added, which is a bit of a shame, but those buildings do look good and now it is clear why you are going against those green rectangles and why those red dots (people) are restricted by those green rectangles.

notes.title: DEMO versions release postponed
notes.notes:
Dear Players, Streamers, Media Persons, etc.

As Demo version was originally rushed for Steam Strategy Fest, and as it didn't pass Steams approval process due to Steam's strict policy on AI-generated images, Demo Version is postponed to a later date in the future when the game is first more complete and two AI-generated images are replaced.

The demo version will likely be published still during this year, but right now no date is set in stone yet.

If you are a Media Person, Streamer, or something similar, and want the Demo Version now already, you can ask for a download link from contact@onejoyfulday.com.

notes.title: DEMO Version coming soon (in Steams approval process already)
notes.notes:
Dear Players, Streamers, Media Persons, etc.

The demo version for Steam Strategy Fest purpose for this game is already in the approval process on Steam and could be approved at any moment.

Unfortunately, it didn't make it in time for Steam Strategy Fests beginning, since Steam didn't approve it on the first try since AI has been used on some GFX and Text, and therefore Steam was asking for more details before giving their approval.

If you are a Media Person, Streamer, or something similar, and want the Demo Version now already, you can ask for a download link from contact@onejoyfulday.com.
